claims.text: A descriptive normative message detailing average neighborhood usage produces energy savings in households with high baseline energy consumption.
A descriptive normative message detailing average neighborhood usage produces an undesirable boomerang effect in households with low baseline energy consumption.
Adding an injunctive message conveying social approval or disapproval eliminates the boomerang effect produced by descriptive normative messages.

evidence.description: In a field experiment on household energy conservation, a descriptive normative message detailing average neighborhood usage produced desirable energy savings depending on whether households were consuming at a high rate.

In a field experiment on household energy conservation, a descriptive normative message detailing average neighborhood usage produced an undesirable boomerang effect depending on whether households were already consuming at a low rate.
In the field experiment, adding an injunctive message (conveying social approval or disapproval) eliminated the boomerang effect.

methodologies.name: Household energy conservation field experiment
methodologies.description: A field experiment evaluating the impact of descriptive and injunctive normative messages on household energy conservation across high- and low-consuming households.
conditions: Descriptive normative message with injunctive message

limitations.text: Normative messages have had mixed success in changing behavior in field contexts, with some prior studies showing boomerang effects.
